meals.notes: Jaclyn made it. Spice was too high for the kids — reduce or omit red pepper flakes next time. Cora was OK but noticed the heat; Eve rejected it as too spicy. Confirms medium/sunday difficulty — not a Tuesday/Thursday candidate. Consider halving chilli flakes to 1/4 tsp or making them optional with a 'add at the table' approach.

meals.name: Bolognese Gnocchi
meals.notes: Hit with Cora, Eve, and Jaclyn (Justin traveling). Two recipe tweaks: (1) gnocchi should be thawed before cooking — frozen gnocchi didn't crisp as well; (2) use the whole 5 oz bag of baby spinach instead of measuring 2 cups — easier for the kids to just dump the container and it's the right amount.

meals.name: Bang Bang Shrimp

justin.notes: Too complex for a Thursday-night kid-friendly cook as written. Would work much better if the recipe used already breaded shrimp instead of breading and frying from scratch.

meals.notes: Keep the flavor profile in rotation, but prefer a shortcut version using store-bought breaded shrimp to avoid breading/frying on a school-night. Treat scratch-breaded/fried versions as too complex for Thursday execution.
